s10.old: - **WHISPER DELETES DISFLUENCIES BY DEFAULT - the filler-prompt trick makes it usable (measured 2026-08-20, n=10 attributed C-SPAN turns).** Default whisper-small: **0.0 uh+um per 1k on EVERY clip**. With `initial_prompt='Um, uh, so, you know, I mean, like...'` + `condition_on_previous_text=True`: **37.1 per 1k mean** and a **26x per-member spread** (Takano 121.4, Chu 73.9, Rose 60.5, Schneider 42.4, Green 23.8, Pocan 21.3, Fulcher 10.6, Curtis 7.7, LaHood 5.0, Norton 4.7). Content cost is small: mean coverage vs the C-SPAN reference 0.729 -> 0.699, **delta -0.030**. Corroboration: Gemini independently measured 36.14/1k on an overlapping subset; C-SPAN captions read 0.00. (The `condition_on_previous_text=True` recipe was later found defective over long files - see the 2026-08-24 defect above.)

NOT lower than A- because the lexical/discriminant weakness is FIREWALLED - production targeting runs on behavioral dispositions (validated by construction); the lexical Big-5 is a display layer no engine reads - plus rare process discipline (pre-reg / one-look / de-id / self-correction of the mis-signed composite). ES converted a fragile/stale A- into a firmly-defensible one (retired the unanchored-ES gap) but did NOT lift to A. **Path A- -> A = an independent-TRAIT anchor (multi-rater expert panel / self-report) = DATA COLLECTION, not code.**
